                "y": np.array([10, 20, 30], dtype=np.int64),
                "z": np.array([9, 8], dtype=np.int64),

        )

            window_dim="win",
            stride=2,
            fill_value=-1,
            keep_attrs=False,
        )

        assert isinstance(out, xr.Dataset)
        assert "signal" in out.data_vars
        assert "meta" in out.data_vars
        assert "win" in out["signal"].dims
